minor.issue: date query param is interpolated raw into Mongo $regex (^{date}) without format validation. Caterer-only so low risk, but a malformed/regex-laden date string is accepted. Recommend datetime.strptime validation with 400 on bad input.

Day boundary is UTC (created_at stored as UTC ISO); frontend computes selectedDate in device-local timezone (sales.tsx:24-28) while the label uses server-returned sales.date. Around midnight local-vs-UTC (e.g. IST 00:00-05:30) prev/next can show the same date twice or skip a day. Edge-case only; consistent for most of the day.

issues: Empty-date export message says 'No orders to export for today yet.' even when viewing a PAST date — matches the requested spec but wording is misleading for history view; consider 'No orders to export for this date.'
